title: Embedded inference: the model, its physics residual and its measurement check as one ONNX graph
description: A 12 k-parameter convolutional surrogate of the advection-diffusion field is trained on the exact solution of the discrete equation the residual stencil writes, exported with the residual, the trust level and the two flags into a single straight-line ONNX graph (no If, Loop or Scan), and measured: 1.5-1.8 kHz on one ARM core, 0.55-0.66 ms per call, and a residual that flags a field moving 2.5x faster than the training data 100 % of the time while never flagging the training distribution.

metrics.name: latency_1_thread
metrics.how: onnxruntime CPUExecutionProvider, intra_op=inter_op=1 thread, 500 timed calls after a warm-up, median

metrics.name: rate_4_threads
metrics.how: 1 / median latency on four threads: more sockets than the graph can use

metrics.name: flagged_out_of_domain
metrics.how: fraction of the speed-2.5x cases whose residual is above the calibrated tolerance of 0.094

metrics.name: flagged_in_domain
metrics.how: fraction of the held-out training-distribution cases above the same tolerance

checks.name: graph_is_straight_line
checks.label: the graph carries no If, Loop or Scan

checks.name: residual_exact_frame
checks.label: the exact next frame scores 0.0 under the stencil, so the residual is the model's own error

checks.name: calibrated_on_held_out
checks.label: the tolerance is 1.5x the median residual of a held-out in-domain sample, not a guess
